video_title: How Jerome Bettis’ Mom Saved Him From LA

quotes.speaker: Jerome Bettis
quotes.summary_phrase: Jerome Bettis on buying his parents a house in Detroit
quotes.excerpt: the first thing I did was I bought mom and dad a house

text_blocks.speaker: Jerome Bettis
text_blocks.text: The first thing I did was I bought mom and dad a house in Detroit. Because obviously we were in the hood, so I bought mom and dad a house on a golf course in the city, laid them out. They were good.

quotes.speaker: Jerome Bettis
quotes.summary_phrase: Jerome Bettis on the challenges of being a young star in LA
quotes.excerpt: I was 21 years old, I got a pocket full of money, and I'm in LA
quotes.quote: I was 21 years old because I left as a junior. So I'm 21, I got a pocket full of money, and I'm in LA. And I was the Rookie of the Year. Come on man. You know what I'm saying? So it was a hard position to be when you're young.

quotes.speaker: Jerome Bettis
quotes.summary_phrase: Jerome Bettis on his mother's foresight to bring him home
quotes.excerpt: the best thing that ever happened to me was my mother that off-season
quotes.quote: The best thing that ever happened to me was my mother that off-season. I had just won Rookie of the Year, all that. And so I got a house that I rented. We had a pool in the back, we had pool parties and stuff, right? Because the season over, right? So every weekend I got a pool party at the house, right? So my mom calls and she says, 'When are you coming home?'

quotes.speaker: Jerome Bettis
quotes.summary_phrase: Jerome Bettis on the strict rules his parents enforced at home
quotes.excerpt: mom and dad laid down the rules of the house
quotes.quote: I go back and I stay at the house, right? And mom and dad laid down the rules of the house, right? They're like, 'No girls in the room, no this, no that.' I'm like, 'I bought the house, what are you talking about?' This is my house. I'm the Rookie of the Year, what you mean? This is my house. No, that's this, this, the, the, that.

quotes.speaker: Jerome Bettis
quotes.summary_phrase: Jerome Bettis on how his mother's humility changed his perspective
quotes.excerpt: the humility that that moment instilled in me, it changed the way that I looked at the situation
quotes.quote: But the humility that that moment instilled in me, it changed the way that I looked at the situation. Because had I stayed out in LA, it would have swallowed me up. And I would be a much different person than I became because of of that moment. So I'm so thankful that that she had the the foresight to say, 'Nah, come on back. Pop that bubble. Come on back, come on home.'
